worldcombat.skill.meditate.summary: Still the body and awaken the power sleeping deep within to raise Attack. The longer you stand undisturbed, the deeper it wakes: in calm it reaches two stages.
worldcombat.skill.meditate.use.0: Before a fight, call Attack up to two stages while nobody disturbs you
worldcombat.skill.meditate.use.1: Under pressure, quickly wake one stage to get your swing back
worldcombat.skill.meditate.use.2: Top up in a safe reprieve and keep Attack padded
worldcombat.skill.meditate.description.0: Meditate to awaken deep power: Attack +%1$s stage(s); undisturbed it wakes one more stage.
worldcombat.skill.meditate.description.2: Settle %1$s s, recover %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s; the settle can be interrupted without paying anything.
worldcombat.skill.meditate.deep.on: Deep breath: calm window x1.4, and only 3 quiet seconds are needed for the extra stage; costs a 2-tick longer settle and 10 longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.meditate.deep.off: Normal breath: faster settle and shorter cooldown, but 7 quiet seconds are needed for the extra stage.
worldcombat.skill.meditate.timing: The settle can be interrupted without paying anything; PP and cooldown settle only after commit.
worldcombat.skill.meditate.growth.0: From level %1$s: calm window %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.meditate.growth.1: From level %1$s: calm window %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.meditate.preference.de: On: calm window x1.4 and 3 quiet seconds unlock the extra stage, at the cost of a 2-tick longer settle and 10 longer cooldown. Off: faster, but 7 quiet seconds are needed.
worldcombat.skill.meditate.preference.ai: Consider meditating when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
Stop meditating and fight when a threat is closer than this; larger gives up the buff more often up close.
On: only start meditating when recently unhurt (extra stage). Off: meditate while being hit too (one stage less).
